title: Ox Passion Pink Guava Nic Salts E-Liquid 10ml
description: OX Passion Pink Guava delivers a bright and exotic fruit vape with a smooth, tropical finish. The Pink Guava flavour is rich and juicy with floral sweetness and a tangy edge, creating a well-rounded taste that’s both bold and refreshing. It’s a distinctive single-fruit profile that offers complexity without overpowering the senses. This nicotine salt e-liquid is blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio and designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping. It delivers fast nicotine absorption with a smooth and satisfying throat hit, making it perfect for use with pod systems, starter pens, and other compact refillable kits. Available in both 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, OX Passion Nic Salts offer bold, layered flavour profiles with a consistently smooth finish. Developed by Oxva, a trusted name in vaping hardware, these e-liquids are expertly crafted to pair seamlessly with Oxva XLIM pod kits and other refillable MTL vape devices.
